items.title: Gary Burton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was 19 when I joined my first name band, George Shearing; 20 when I joined Stan Getz.

ctx.x: “Raish” [PHONETIC] is in there somewhere. Absolutely. When I started out, I was always the youngest guy in the band. I was 17 years old when I made my first records. I was 19 when I joined my first name band, George Shearing; 20 when I joined Stan Getz. So at some point, instead of everybody else being 40 and me being 20, it shifted the other way. I became the older guy, and the band kept staying younger. I thought about this a lot, and I realized I was influenced by Stan, who also had a history of finding and…
Since we’re talking about your earlier years, how did you start playing with George Shearing, I think in 1963?
